prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished standalone widescreen 16:9 high resolution pixel-art illustration, preferably 2560x1440 or highest native resolution, for chapter 1 of Rough Cut's opening. Extremely detailed small pixel clusters, deliberate pixel edges and restrained dithering, original adventure-game realism, NOT coarse block art, NOT smooth painted art with a pixel filter. Scene: insurer's private executive golf course after closing, from the south service entrance, empty striped fairways leading through dark pine woods, pond and reed beds to right under low thin mist, a distant low clubhouse with a few amber windows, tall floodlights, wet path lit by sparse paired low amber lanterns. Dark blue-grey cloud layered sky with pale partly hidden moon, muted olive and cool green foliage, weathered timber, tiny amber highlights. Wide cinematic establishing shot, no people, eerie quiet routine evening, rich readable midtones and intricate grass/reed detail, not crushed black. Main storytelling content central 70 percent for safe cropping; no UI, captions, lettering, logos or watermark. The game follows an analyst sent across this automated turf-sensor pilot on one last work errand. Make the atmosphere grounded and ominous, no monsters yet.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE finished high resolution widescreen 16:9 pixel-art narrative illustration, highest native resolution. Chapter 2 of Rough Cut, same grounded dark golf-course horror aesthetic as the previous establishing illustration. Fine deliberate pixel clusters, crisp small pixel edges, intricate hand-dithered textures, lifelike proportions, not large pixel blocks, not photorealistic/smooth painting. Close three-quarter view inside a weathered timber service kiosk just inside a golf course entrance at night: battered desk under a single hooded amber lamp, a cream signed work order with three empty stamp boxes, old rubber stamp and inkpad, small sketched course map with winding path, pond, tiny shed and culvert symbol, a tarnished key ring on a closed metal key cabinet BEHIND the desk (not being given to player), a handwritten caution tucked under the order, a pen, old telephone and compact turf sensor monitor with status lights. Paper markings are indistinct tiny handwriting strokes, NO readable letters or words, NO embedded captions. Through dark window, wet green striped fairway, pine trunks, low mist and distant floodlight; blue-grey moonlit clouds. Document and three empty boxes are main visual focus. Tactile woodgrain, brass patina, creased paper, moss and chipped paint, muted olive/cool green/navy with warm amber pools, ominous administrative abandonment. Composition central 70% safe for screen cropping; no borders, watermarks, giant text or UI.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE standalone highest-native-resolution widescreen 16:9 detailed pixel-art illustration for chapter 3 of Rough Cut. Maintain original game's high resolution small-pixel adventure horror art, tiny deliberate pixel clusters and dithered shading, realistic anatomy, intricate foliage, NO coarse blocky geometry, no smooth photographic painting. Moonlit executive golf course after closing, dark olive pines, slate-blue cloud layers, amber floodlights reflected on wet striped fairway, low silver mist at knee level. Viewed from behind a timber post and reeds at fairway edge. In middle distance 15 metres away stands JOE, middle-aged white male with short dark-brown neatly side-parted swept hair, slight widow's peak, dark stubble, strong brows; wears black V-neck pullover over a pale small-check collared office shirt, charcoal trousers and brown shoes. Joe is walking side-on, pushing a battered low olive walk-behind lawn mower with four wheels, rusted steel cutting deck and tubular black handle, NOT riding mower or golfcart. Figure small enough to feel far away but recognizable; head angled down, face partly obscured by brow/shadow, posture oddly intent, no monster exaggeration. Fresh cut strip extends behind him. Turf telemetry box on a post, tall grass foreground, distant low clubhouse windows almost dark. Most of frame quiet empty fairway, ominous isolation. Central safe composition, no lettering, captions, UI, border, watermark. Keep crisp pixel-crafted edges rather than blur.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE finished standalone widescreen 16:9 high resolution detailed pixel-art illustration, highest native resolution, chapter 4 Rough Cut opening. Fine small deliberate pixel clusters and dithered texture, grounded realistic adventure game art, NOT coarse block pixels or blurred painterly art. View from INSIDE the same private golf course at night, looking obliquely back at a heavy wooden south service gate that is now shut: dark wet weathered timber planks and rusty reinforced frame, conspicuous chain and padlock stretched between gate leaves in central foreground, amber utility lamp dying above, small turf-control electrical cabinet. Beyond/alongside gate only unlit access road outside; no apparent walkable opening around it. In background INSIDE the course, a small distant weathered maintenance shed with faint amber doorway at one side and a low mossy masonry drainage culvert with bars and trickle of water at the other, subtle possible alternatives, not arrows/signposts. Pine woods, layered blue-grey cloud sky, cool moonlight, wet grasses, olive foliage and low mist. Composition feels hemmed in, three depths, tactile rusty chain is focal detail. Keep shed and drain understated; no giant icons or text. Central safe composition, no people, no words, captions, logos, watermark or UI. Match muted dark green/blue and restrained warm amber lighting of previous course images.

Recompose this original Rough Cut illustration into the FINAL SHOT of a five-image opening story. Keep Joe's precise identity and the original high-resolution pixel art craftsmanship: same middle-aged male face, swept side-parted short brown hair, slight widow's peak, stubble, strong brows, black V-neck sweater, pale small-check shirt collar, dark trousers. CHANGE camera/composition: first-person view from a moonlit wet golf fairway, fresh parallel mower tracks and cut grass leading away from the bottom foreground into thin knee-level mist. Joe is now standing motionless six to eight metres ahead, slightly off centre, both hands resting on the tubular handle of a battered olive walk-behind four-wheel lawnmower. He has stopped mowing and turned his head and shoulders directly toward the viewer, a restrained knowing half-smile, human expression but ominous fixed attention. Show full body and entire mower at medium distance, NOT closeup face, not riding mower. Dark pines and distant floodlights, low clubhouse now dark, blue-grey layered cloudy night sky with partial moon, muted greens and restrained amber details match earlier course scenes. Original fine deliberate small pixel clusters, sharp hand-dithered highlights, detailed grass and cloth, not coarse block pixels, no smooth photo look. Highest native resolution widescreen 16:9, one full illustration, central safe framing, no text/captions/logos/watermark, no gore, no explicit monsters.
